skills.name: Basic Attack: Tongue Flick
skills.description:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Launch up to four attacks forward, dealing Electric DMG.
When the 4th hit lands, gain 2 points of Venom. Hitting a Stunned enemy grants an additional 1 point of Venom.

skills.name: Basic Attack: Serpent's Kiss
skills.description:
With Serpentine Shadow, hold [Basic Attack] to launch:
Cissia leaps into the air and locks onto a target, then slams down, dealing Electric DMG to enemies in the area.
While locking on, continue to hold [Basic Attack] and drag the {LAYOUT_CONSOLECONTROLLER#stick}{LAYOUT_FALLBACK#joystick} to extend the lock-on duration and freely control the landing position.
For every 6 points of Venom gained, gain 1 stack of Serpentine Shadow, stacking up to 3 times.
Upon entering the battlefield, gain 1 stack of Serpentine Shadow.
Using this skill consumes 1 stack of Serpentine Shadow.
Upon hitting an enemy, all Venom is consumed to trigger Corrode Bone.
Upon activating this skill, a Quick Assist is triggered.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Corrode Bone
skills.description:
Deal Electric DMG to nearby enemies.
Each trigger increases CRIT Rate by 6% for 15s, stacking up to 3 times. Repeated triggers refresh the duration.

skills.name: Special Attack: Bared Fangs
skills.description:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Launches a long-range snake bite forward, dealing Electric DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

skills.name: EX Special Attack: Venomous Bite
skills.description:
With enough energy, press or hold [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Unleash multiple long-range snake bites forward, dealing Electric DMG.
Grants 5 Energy when the move is used.
When activating by holding, consumes additional Energy. For every 20 additional Energy consumed, unleash 1 extra strike that deals Electric DMG, up to a maximum of 60 additional Energy.
After activation, gain 3 Venom. For every additional 20 Energy consumed while holding, gain 1 more Venom.
After using this skill, it can be immediately followed up with the 4th hit of Basic Attack: Tongue Flick.
A Quick Assist is triggered when this skill hits an enemy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Dodge: Slither
skills.description:
Press [Dodge] to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Dash Attack: Bite Mark
skills.description:
Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
Dash forward with a swift slash, dealing Electric DMG.

skills.name: Dodge Counter: Bite Back
skills.description:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Leap forward and perform a sweeping attack upon landing, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Chain Attack: Gang Operation
skills.description:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Launch multiple attacks ahead, dealing massive Electric DMG.
After using this skill, gain 3 Venom.
A Quick Assist is triggered when this skill hits an enemy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Ultimate: Ophidiophobia
skills.description:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Deliver a thunderbolt attack in front, dealing massive Electric DMG.
After using this skill, obtain 3 Venom.
After using this skill, activate Ether Veil: Cold-Blooded, lasting 30s. All squad members' CRIT DMG increases by 5% for the duration.
Re-activating Ether Veil: Cold-Blooded a second time will first deactivate the active Ether Veil: Cold-Blooded.
A Quick Assist is triggered when this skill hits an enemy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Quick Assist: Alarm System
skills.description:
When the active character is launched, press [Assist] to activate:
Leaps forward and performs a sweeping attack upon landing, dealing Electric DMG.
During this skill, you can quickly chain into Special Attack: Bared Fangs, EX Special Attack: Venomous Bite, and Basic Attack: Serpent's Kiss.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Defensive Assist: Extra Prison Rations
skills.description:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Assist] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Assist Follow-Up: Partners in Crime
skills.description:
Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Unleash a series of attacks, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Core Passive: Fatal Concoction
skills.description:
Upon entering the battlefield, gain 3 Venom. In Investigation Zone mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s.
While possessing Venom, consume 1 Venom every 5s while in combat to trigger Corrode Bone, dealing Electric DMG.
With Venom, all squad memebrs' Electric DMG ignores 6% of enemy DEF. If initial Energy Regen is higher than 1.4, for every additional 0.12 above that threshold, an additional 1% of the enemy's DEF is ignored, up to a maximum of 25% of enemy DEF. This effect lasts until 30s after Venom is depleted.
Corrode Bone deals additional Electric DMG equal to 335% of ATK.
When there are 1/2 Electric characters in the squad, the Daze dealt by Corrode Bone increases by 40%/60%.
When gaining Venom, every 1 excess point of Venom triggers Corrode Bone once.

skills.name: Additional Ability: Festering Venom
skills.description:
When another character in your squad is a Stun character or shares the same attribute:
While possessing Venom, increases all squad members' CRIT DMG by 40%, with Cissia gaining an additional 10%. The effect lasts until 30s after Venom is depleted.

mindscapes.name: Traveler and Prey
mindscapes.description: The Venom gained upon entering the battlefield increases to 6. The DEF ignore from the Core Passive increases to 140% of its original value, and all squad members ignore 5% of the target's Electric RES. Corrode Bone DMG ignores 10% of the target's Electric RES.

mindscapes.name: Hunger and Hard Truths
mindscapes.description: After a Chain Attack: Gang Operation or Ultimate: Ophidiophobia hits a Stunned enemy, gain an additional 3 Venom. Basic Attack: Serpent's Kiss deals 35% increased DMG.

mindscapes.name: Chains and a Warm Nest
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

mindscapes.name: A Rogue's Resolve
mindscapes.description: When using an EX Special Attack, Chain Attack, or Ultimate, gain 1 stack of Decidedness, stacking up to 3 times. When using Basic Attack: Serpent's Kiss, consume all Decidedness. Each stack consumed triggers 1 special instance of Corrode Bone that does not consume Venom. This Corrode Bone does not cause Daze.

mindscapes.name: False Evidence and Fangs
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

mindscapes.name: Home and Sixth Street
mindscapes.description: Each time Corrode Bone is triggered, gain 1 stack of Bone-Deep Corrosion. When attacks from any squad member, other than Corrode Bone, hit an enemy, consume 1 stack of Bone-Deep Corrosion to trigger 1 special Corrode Bone. This instance of Corrode Bone cannot inflict Daze, and at most 1 stack of Bone-Deep Corrosion can be consumed every 3s.
